isOnSale.description: If true, indicates that the product is discounted from its original price. See `strikethroughPrice` for the original price and `savingsPercent` for the percentage of discount.

isStartingFrom.description: If true, indicates that there are multiple variants with different prices. Can be used in the frontend to indicate a starting-from price, e.g. "from 100 EUR".

Money.description: A Money object describes a monetary value. You can use e.g. `@screeny05/ts-money` to create and manipulate Money objects more elegantly.
Money.title: Money

amount.description: Amount in smallest unit of currency. E.g. cents, pence, etc.

UnitPrice.description: This object descibes a unit-price, e.g. 13.99 EUR / 100g
UnitPrice.title: UnitPrice

Measurement.description: A value-object representing a measurement of a physical quantity. E.g. length, weight, etc.
Measurement.title: Measurement
